mcp_ignatious_api.name: Ignatious Kanban API
mcp_ignatious_api.description: Tools to manage projects, tasks, and users in the Ignatious Kanban system.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Retrieve a list of tasks, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Filter tasks by this specific status.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in the system.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the task.

assignee.description: Optional identifier for the user or agent assigned to the task.

status.description: Initial status of the task. Defaults to Ready for Action.

project_id.description: The ID of the project this task belongs to. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Update the status of an existing task (e.g., move it between Kanban columns).

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update.

status.description: The new status for the task.

tools.name: get_users
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all registered users in the system.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently remove a task from the system.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to delete.
